ro.name: Primăria din Inverurie

en.name: Inverurie Town Hall

en.text: A significant Pictish symbol stone featuring Ogham inscriptions, found in the Brandsbutt area near the town centre.

en.name: Bass of Inverurie
en.text: The remains of a 12th-century motte-and-bailey castle that once served as the administrative centre of the Garioch.

en.name: Garioch Heritage Centre
en.text: A museum housed in a former locomotive works, showcasing the industrial and social history of the Garioch region.

en.name: St Andrew's Parish Church
en.text: A neo-Gothic church built in 1842, defining the skyline with its prominent tower and distinctive granite masonry.

en.name: Ury Riverside Park
en.text: A large recreational area along the River Ury, providing wildlife habitats and popular walking paths for residents.

en.name: Bennachie Visitor Centre
en.text: The gateway to the iconic Bennachie hill range, featuring exhibits on the natural and human history of the area.

en.name: Easter Aquhorthies Stone Circle
en.text: A remarkably well-preserved Bronze Age recumbent stone circle located just outside Inverurie on a hillside.

en.name: Thainstone Mart
en.text: One of the largest livestock markets in Europe, acting as a major economic engine for North East Scotland's agriculture.

en.name: Inverurie War Memorial
en.text: A prominent granite monument dedicated to those who fell in the World Wars, situated in the heart of the town.

descriptionAdvanced.de: Inverurie ist eine charmante und schnell wachsende Marktstadt in Aberdeenshire, Schottland, etwa 25 Kilometer nordwestlich von Aberdeen. Sie liegt strategisch günstig am Zusammenfluss der Flüsse Don und Ury und dient als administratives und wirtschaftliches Zentrum des Garioch-Distrikts. Die Geschichte der Stadt reicht bis in das 13. Jahrhundert zurück, als sie zur Royal Burgh ernannt wurde. Ein bedeutendes historisches Ereignis in der Nähe war die Schlacht von Harlaw im Jahr 1411. Heute ist Inverurie für seinen florierenden lokalen Markt und seine unabhängigen Geschäfte bekannt, die Besucher aus der gesamten Region anziehen. Die Stadt ist auch ein Tor zum berühmten Bennachie-Hügel, einem Wahrzeichen der Highlands. Die lokale Wirtschaft wurde traditionell durch die Landwirtschaft und die Papierherstellung geprägt, profitiert aber heute stark von der Öl- und Gasindustrie in Aberdeen. Die Architektur der Stadt zeigt viele Gebäude aus dem charakteristischen grauen Granit der Region.
descriptionAdvanced.hu: Inverurie egy dinamikusan fejlődő skót mezőváros Aberdeenshire szívében, a Don és az Ury folyók találkozásánál. A település történelme a kora középkorig nyúlik vissza; királyi városi (Royal Burgh) rangját még a 13. században kapta. A környék gazdag régészeti leletekben, többek között pikt faragott kövekben, mint például a híres Maiden Stone. A város fejlődését a 19. században a vasút és a papírgyártás lendítette fel, mára pedig Aberdeen fontos alvóvárosává és kereskedelmi központjává vált. Inverurie híres a helyi termelői piacairól és a Garioch Heritage Centre-ről, amely a vidék ipari és kulturális múltját mutatja be. A település hátterében magasodik a Bennachie-hegy, amely a környék legnépszerűbb kirándulóhelye. Gazdaságilag az agrárágazat mellett a gépipar és az energiatermeléshez kapcsolódó szolgáltatások is jelentősek. A városközpontot a hagyományos gránitépületek és a díszes városháza határozzák meg.
descriptionAdvanced.ro: Inverurie este un oraș de piață prosper situat în Aberdeenshire, Scoția, servind drept punct central pentru districtul agricol Garioch. Așezat la intersecția râurilor Don și Ury, orașul are o istorie de peste 700 de ani ca burg regal. Unul dintre cele mai notabile puncte de reper din apropiere este monumentul Bătăliei de la Harlaw, care comemorează un conflict sângeros din 1411. Dezvoltarea modernă a orașului a fost stimulată de construirea canalului Inverurie la începutul secolului al XIX-lea, urmat de calea ferată. Astăzi, Inverurie este o destinație populară pentru cumpărături, având o piață săptămânală activă și numeroase afaceri locale independente. Dealul Bennachie domină orizontul orașului, oferind trasee spectaculoase pentru drumeții. Comunitatea beneficiază de facilități moderne, inclusiv centrul cultural Garioch Heritage Centre. Arhitectura urbană este marcată de utilizarea granitului local, oferind un aspect solid și istoric centrului orașului.
descriptionAdvanced.en: Inverurie is a thriving market town in Aberdeenshire, Scotland, positioned at the scenic confluence of the rivers Don and Ury. Historically established as a Royal Burgh in the 13th century, it has long served as the focal point for the fertile Garioch lands. The town's surroundings are steeped in ancient history, featuring Pictish standing stones and the site of the historic Battle of Harlaw (1411). During the 19th century, Inverurie expanded with the arrival of the Aberdeenshire Canal and the North of Scotland Railway, which transformed it into an industrial and transport hub. Today, it combines a rich heritage with a modern, fast-growing population, largely driven by its proximity to the energy capital, Aberdeen. The town is famous for its vibrant high street, award-winning independent shops, and the Garioch Heritage Centre. With the iconic Bennachie hill range providing a dramatic backdrop, Inverurie remains a key destination for tourists exploring the Scottish Highlands' history and natural beauty.
